description:
Archie #15 (2017), Archie Comics - Cover A by Joe Eisma featuring Cheryl Blossom, with the Riverdale (The CW) premiere banner. Written by Mark Waid, art by Joe Eisma. Archie is "becoming Jughead" while the Veronica vs. Cheryl Blossom feud reaches its fever pitch. Direct edition, $3.99 cover price.

Condition: bright, clean covers with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
